description: This file defines the interface 'TaxReadPlatformService' which provides methods to retrieve tax component and tax group data in the Fineract platform.

classes.name: TaxReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface for retrieving tax component and group data in the platform.

methods.name: retrieveTaxComponentData
methods.description: Retrieves a specific tax component data by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveTaxComponentTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template for creating a new tax component.

methods.name: retrieveTaxGroupData
methods.description: Retrieves a specific tax group data by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveTaxGroupWithTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a tax group with its template for editing or creation.

methods.name: retrieveTaxGroupTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template for creating a new tax group.

methods.name: retrieveTaxGroupsForLookUp
methods.description: Retrieves tax groups suitable for lookup purposes.
